description: Start a rental. You must read the Rental Terms (https://galaxymind.space/terms/rental) and pass accept_terms=true with terms_version="2026-10-16-draft". Pool: give pool_id (catalog: braiins, braiins-solo, ocean, f2pool, antpool, viabtc, luxor, spiderpool, nicehash, parasite, ckpool-solo, public-pool, solopool) OR custom_url (host:port of any other public pool), plus username (your worker or payout address, in the pool's format). No password: it is set for you. Catalog pools start right after payment. A custom pool needs manual approval after payment, which can take up to about 2 hours; if it is not approved the payment is refunded. Returns an x402 USDC payment request on Base that expires in 15 minutes, plus a creatorSecret for status and cancel. A human must pay it; this tool never spends funds. To pay, send accepts[0] back unchanged as `accepted` (extra.orderRef is checked, so an edited or reused requirement is refused before any money moves). A 200 with outcome 'retry' means you have paid and the rental is being finished: don't pay again, check get_rental_status instead. Lightning is coming soon.

accept_terms.description: Must be true: you accept the Rental Terms at https://galaxymind.space/terms/rental.

custom_url.description: Any other pool, as host:port or stratum+tcp://host:port (public hostname only; no IPs, logins, paths or other schemes). Needs manual approval after payment, up to about 2 hours; refunded if not approved.

days.description: Whole days, 1 to 7 in the pilot.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key; retries with the same key return the same rental.

pool_id.description: A catalog pool (auto-approved). Username format per pool: braiins=account[.worker]; braiins-solo=btc_address[.worker]; ocean=btc_address[.worker]; f2pool=account[.worker]; antpool=account[.worker]; viabtc=account[.worker]; luxor=account[.worker]; spiderpool=account[.worker]; nicehash=nicehash_address[.worker]; parasite=btc_address[.worker]; ckpool-solo=btc_address[.worker]; public-pool=btc_address[.worker]; solopool=btc_address[.worker]. Give pool_id or custom_url, not both. Note for solopool: SoloPool.com sets the payout mode per BTC address across the whole pool. This rental connects with password 'x', which puts YOUR payout address in 100% solo mode. If you also mine to the same address elsewhere on solopool.com in Solo Split or Prop mode, those workers switch to 100% solo too. Solo mining pays only when a block is found, so most rentals earn nothing. Use a separate address if you want to keep another mode.

rail.description: x402_usdc (default, the only live rail). lightning returns lightning_coming_soon.

terms_version.description: The Rental Terms version you accepted. Current: 2026-10-16-draft.

username.description: Required. Your pool worker or payout address: account[.worker], btc_address[.worker] or nicehash_address[.worker] for catalog pools; 1 to 64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - for custom pools.

name: create_rental
